20 Bamburi Cement Limited
Annual Report & Financial Statements 2015

Board of Directors Profiles (continued)
CHRIS C. KISIRE, 49 BComm, MBA, CPA (K), CPS (K)
Chris is the Chief Finance Officer, National Bank Limited. He has business experience
spanning over twenty four years in Finance, Administration and Business Management both
locally and internationally in various industries (Courier, Logistics, Media, Oil, Private Equity
Investment, Finance, Manufacturing and Horticulture). He is an alumnus of University of
Nairobi (both under and post graduate degrees), Strathmore Business School/IESE, AMP
2010 and a member of ICPAK and ICPSK. Chris took over as Chairperson of the Audit
Committee in August 2015.
SHEILA M’MBIJJEWE, MBS, 58 ICAEW, CPA(K)
Sheila is the Deputy Governor, Central Bank of Kenya. She previously held several leadership
positions at PricewaterhouseCoopers, Stagecoach International and Standard Chartered
Bank Kenya. Sheila was also a member of the Monetary Policy Committee of the Central
Bank of Kenya.
Sheila is a member of the Audit Committee but stepped down in June 2015 from the role of
Chairperson.
DOMINIQUE DROUET 62 BA Maths, MCivEng
Dominique joined the Holcim Group in 1994 as CEO, Holcim Outre-Mer after having worked
in several other companies for 16 years. Thereafter, he held similar positions in Lebanon
and Morocco. At the end of 2014, Dominique was appointed as the Holcim Area Manager in
charge of Africa Middle East.
In 2015, following the Lafarge and Holcim merger, Dominique was appointed the
LafargeHolcim Area Manager, East Africa and Indian Ocean. He was subsequently appointed
to the Board in August 2015.
He is a member of the Nomination & Corporate Governance Committee.
